topic: Ordering an Official Bank Statement for a Visa File

script.title: THE VISA STATEMENT
script.scene_zh: 銀行櫃台 · 申辦正式對帳單
script.story_hook: Her visa file needs one very official paper.
script.intro_zh: 她的簽證資料，還少一張正式的銀行對帳單。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's bank scene. Listen for document request phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的銀行場景。留意申請正式文件的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a visa paper trail, complete. Listen again and try the polite asks.
script.outro_zh: 簽證的文件鏈就這樣補齊了。再聽一次，跟著說那些有禮的問句。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: I don't count the lucky one
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early twenties with straight black hair past her shoulders clipped to one side, a cream knit sweater, small stud earrings, a brown messenger bag, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a Middle Eastern man in his thirties with short black hair, a trimmed full beard, rimless glasses, a charcoal suit vest over a crisp white shirt, and a broad build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, can I get an official bank statement, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kən aɪ ɡɛt ən əˈfɪʃəl bæŋk ˈsteɪtmənt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，麻煩幫我一張正式的銀行對帳單，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. How many months does your visa file need?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ haʊ ˈmʌnəts dʊz jɔɹ ˈvaɪzə faɪl nid/
dialogue.zh: 可以。你的簽證資料需要幾個月的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six months, and it's for a visa application.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈmʌnəts ænd ɪts fɚ ə ˈvaɪzə ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 六個月，是為了申請簽證用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it — those need the stamped kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ðoz nid ðə stæmp kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 了解——簽證要的是蓋章的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamped? Is a printed PDF not good enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmpz ɪz ə ˈpriːntɪd ˌpiːdiːˈɛf nɑt ɡʊd ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 蓋章？自己列印的 PDF 不夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Embassies want ink, a seal, and original signatures.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmbəˌsiz wɑnt ɪŋk ə sil ænd əˈrɪdʒənəl ˈsɪɡnətʃɚz/
dialogue.zh: 使館要的是真墨水、章戳，還有親筆簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, right. My appointment is soon, um, this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ɹaɪt maɪ əˈpɔɪntmənt ɪz sun ʌm ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 對，對。我的預約就在這週，呃，很快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's do this early, that's smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts du ðɪs ˈɜrli ðæts smɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就提早辦好，這樣很聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. What exactly will the statement show?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju wət ɪɡˈzæktli wɪl ðə ˈsteɪtmənt ʃoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。對帳單上會列出哪些資料？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name, address, account number, and monthly balances.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm əˈdɛɹs əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbɚ ænd ˈmʌnθli ˈbælənsəz/
dialogue.zh: 姓名、地址、帳號，還有每個月的餘額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it show every deposit and withdrawal too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt ʃoʊ ˈɛvɹi dɪˈpɑzɪt ænd wɪðˈdrɔəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 那每一筆存入和提取都會列出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full history, line by line, over six months.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ˈhɪstɹi laɪn baɪ laɪn ˈoʊvɚ sɪks ˈmʌnəθs/
dialogue.zh: 六個月的完整紀錄，一行一行都列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my account number safe on something like that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbɚ seɪf ɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 那種文件上，我的帳號安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We mask all but the last four digits.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mæsk ɑl bʌt ðə læst fɔɹ ˈdɪdʒəts/
dialogue.zh: 我們只露出最後四碼，其他都會遮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, I was worried about copying it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd aɪ wəz ˈwɝid əˈbaʊt ˈkɑpiɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那好，我還在擔心影印的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, the sealed envelope stays unopened.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɝiz ðə siːld ˈɛnvəˌloʊp steɪz ʌnˈoʊpənd/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，信封會密封著，不會讓人隨便打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sealed? Can I even read my own statement?
dialogue.phonetic: /siːld kən aɪ ˈivən ɹid maɪ ˈoʊn ˈsteɪtmənt/
dialogue.zh: 密封？那我自己能打開看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, but embassies trust sealed more, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn bʌt ˈɛmbəˌsiz tɹʌst sild mɔɹ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，但說實話，使館比較相信密封的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes sense. Is there a fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks sɛns ɪz ðɛr ə fim/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。這要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight dollars for official, mailed statements cost extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈdɑlərz fɚ əˈfɪʃəl ˈmelɪd ˈsteɪtmənts kɑst ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 正式的是八美元，如果要郵寄就另外再加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather pick it up here, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈɹæðɚ pɪk ɪt hɪɹ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實我比較想來分行自己取。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call — branch pickup is just the eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl bræntʃ ˈpɪkˌʌp ɪz dʒʌst ðə eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 選得好——來分行自取只要八美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. How long until it's ready?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt haʊ lɔŋ ʌnˈtɪl ɪts ˈɹiːdi/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。多久可以準備好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Normally five business days, standard processing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔɹməli faɪv ˈbɪznəs deɪz ˈstændɚd pɹəˈsɛsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一般辦件是五個工作天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five... hmm, my flight is in three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv həm maɪ flaɪt ɪz ɪn θɹi wiks/
dialogue.zh: 五天……嗯，我三個星期後就搭機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then standard timing should still beat your trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈstændɚd ˈtaɪmɪŋ ʃʊd stɪl bit jɔɹ trɪp/
dialogue.zh: 那正常流程應該還是趕得上你的行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, um, my embassy appointment is sooner.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʌm maɪ ˈɛmbəˌsi əˈpɔɪntmənt ɪz ˈsuːnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，可是我約的使館面談更早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, that's the tricky part. When exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæts ðə ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt wɛn ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那這是麻煩的地方了。確切是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thursday morning. I know, I know, late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ aɪ noʊ aɪ noʊ leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 星期四早上。我知道，我知道，很臨時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, we can rush it, but hear me out.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wi kən ɹʌʃ ɪt bʌt hɪɹ mi ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我們可以加急，但先聽我說完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, I'm listening very hard right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz aɪm ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈvɛɹi hɑɹd ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 請說，我現在聽得很專心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rush means tomorrow afternoon, plus a ten dollar fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹʌʃ minz təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈæftɚˈnun plʌz ə tɛn ˈdɑləɹ fim/
dialogue.zh: 加急就是明天下午取，另收十美元急件費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten to save the whole trip? Where do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn tə seɪv ðə hoʊl trɪp wɛɹ du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 十美元能救整個旅程？要在哪裡簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here, form's short: account, months, delivery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ fɔɹmz ʃɔɹt əˈkaʊnt mʌnθs dɪˈlɪvɚi/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，表很短：帳號、月數、取件方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Oh, one thing — the name order!
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn oʊ wʌn θɪŋ ðə ˈneɪm ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。噢，還有一件事——姓名的順序！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about it? Tell me before I print it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wət əˈbaʊt ɪt tɛl mi bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ prɪnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？列印之前先告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My passport lists LIU before MEI-LIN.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpæspɔɹt lɪsts ˈliu bɪˈfɔɹ ˈmeɪ lɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我的護照上，姓 LIU 排在名字 MEI-LIN 前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The statement copies the passport, not our file?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsteɪtmənt ˈkɑpiz ðə ˈpæspɔɹt nɑt aʊɹ faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 所以對帳單跟著護照，而不是我們的帳戶資料？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! Can the statement match my passport exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kən ðə ˈsteɪtmənt mætʃ maɪ ˈpæspɔɹt ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 對！可以讓對帳單和護照完全一致嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can add a name note, it's routine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən æd ə neɪm noʊt ɪts ruˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 我們能加一條姓名備註，這是例行做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're speaking my language now, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈspiːkɪŋ maɪ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ naʊ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 你現在說到我心坎裡了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I've fixed this for ten visa files already.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪv fɪkst ðɪs fɚ tɛn ˈvaɪzə ˈfaɪlz ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這種簽證資料我已經修過十份了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten! Please tell me they all got their visas.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn pliz tɛl mi ðeɪ ɔl ɡɑt ðɛɹ ˈvisaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 十份！請告訴我他們都拿到簽證了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine of ten, but I don't count the lucky one.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn əv tɛn bʌt aɪ doʊnt kaʊnt ðə ˈlʌki wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 十份裡中了九份，不過幸運的那個我不算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like to be your tenth, very much.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bi jɔɹ ˈtɛnθ ˈvɛɹi mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那我好想當你的第十份啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Thursday you'll walk in with the envelope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈθɝzdeɪ jul wɔk ɪn wɪð ði ˈɛnvəˌloʊp/
dialogue.zh: 那星期四你就能帶著信封走進使館了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if they want proof of my balance again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət ɪf ðeɪ wɑnt pɹuf əv maɪ ˈbæləns əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 如果他們另外還要餘額證明呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We print a one-page balance letter with it, free.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi prɪnt ə wʌn ˈpeɪdʒ ˈbæləns ˈlɛɾɚ wɪð ɪt fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我們會附一張單頁的餘額證明，免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? That letter usually costs money, I hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ðæt ˈlɛɾɚ ˈjuʒəwəli kɑsts ˈmʌni aɪ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 免費？我聽說這種證明通常都要錢的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at this branch. We like students passing.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt æt ðɪs bræntʃ wi laɪk ˈstudənts ˈpæsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們分行不會——我們喜歡看到學生過關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing — is the statement in English?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ ɪz ðə ˈsteɪtmənt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事——對帳單是英文的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, plus your name matches the passport spelling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz plʌz jɔɹ ˈneɪm ˈmætʃəz ðə ˈpæspɔɹt ˈspɛlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 永遠是英文，而且姓名會照護照的拼法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, ID for pickup, or can my dad go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪˈdi fɚ ˈpɪkˌʌp ɔɹ kən maɪ dæd ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，領取要帶身分證嗎？還是我爸來代領可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can, with your signed note and his license.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæn wɪð jɔɹ saɪnd noʊt ænd hɪz ˈlaɪsəns/
dialogue.zh: 他可以，只要帶著你簽名的委託信和他的駕照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write that tonight, this is such a relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹaɪt ðæt təˈnaɪt ðɪs ɪz sʌtʃ ə ɹɪˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就寫好這封信，這樣我就安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your claim slip, code V-two-two, see you tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz jɔɹ kleɪm slɪp koʊd ˈvi tu ˈtu si ju təˈmɑɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這是你的取件單，代號 V22，明天見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: V-two-two. Tomorrow afternoon. Thursday's covered!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvi tu ˈtu təˈmɑɹoʊ ˈæftɚˈnun ˈθɝzdeɪz ˈkʌvɚd/
dialogue.zh: V22。明天下午。星期四就沒問題了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Covered. Bring snacks for the wait, it's lively here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvɚd bɹɪŋ snæks fɚ ðə weɪt ɪts ˈlaɪvli hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。要等的話帶點零食來，我們這裡很熱鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I'll bring the whole family if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl bɹɪŋ ðə hoʊl ˈfæməli ɪf ˈnidæd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，需要的話，我把全家都帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, we could use the excitement. Good luck!
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du wi kəd juz ði ɪkˈsaɪtmənt ɡʊd lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 那就太歡迎了——我們正需要一點熱鬧。祝你好運！

script.youtube_title: 【簽證財力證明📄】「幸運的那個我不算」官方對帳單這樣辦🏦✈️｜六個月明細・蓋章密封・隔天加急｜聽完就會用｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Official Bank Statement
script.youtube_title_en: "I Don't Count the Lucky One" — Ordering a Bank Statement for a Visa
script.youtube_description:
簽證要附財力證明，銀行的對帳單到底該怎麼申請？這一集 60 句沉浸式英語聽力，帶你走進美國銀行櫃台，從六個月明細一路聽到隔天加急取件。

你會聽到：向行員說明簽證需要的正式文件；為什麼使館只相信蓋章與密封信封；帳號要不要擔心外流、信封自己能不能打開；費用、工作天與加急的問句；還有姓名順序跟護照不一致時的關鍵處理。

整段對話都是 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，充滿真實語感：um、well、please、ha。聽完你就會用：an official bank statement、How long until it's ready、sealed envelope、Where do I sign。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，大聲跟著唸，把申請文件的英文唸成直覺。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成母語。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
Your visa file needs proof of funds, but how do you actually order an official bank statement? This 60-line immersive listening practice sits with you at a US bank counter, from six months of history to a next-day rush pickup.

You will hear: explaining the visa requirement, why embassies trust ink, seals, and closed envelopes, hiding account numbers, fees and business days, and the big one — making the name order match your passport.

Everything stays in A2-level words, ten per line at most, with real texture: um, well, please, ha. By the end you'll own lines like How long until it's ready and Where do I sign.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let official English become instinct.

簽證資料清單上寫著「六個月正式對帳單」，自己印的 PDF 為什麼不算？蓋了章的信封為什麼不能開？姓名順序跟護照不一樣，使館會不會退件？

這一集帶大家走進美國銀行的文件櫃台，從問清月數、確認帳號安全、選擇自取還是郵寄，一路聽到加急費與姓名備註，共 60 句連續真實對話。
